# Tekalis - Boutique Électronique & High-Tech au Sénégal

## About
Tekalis is an online electronics and high-tech store based in Dakar Fann, Senegal. We sell smartphones, laptops, TVs, home appliances, gaming equipment, air conditioners, solar energy systems, and tech accessories. We offer delivery throughout Senegal with express delivery in the Dakar region.

## Location
- Address: Fann, Rue 14, Dakar, Sénégal
- Phone: +221 78 634 69 46
- Email: contact@tekalis.com
- Service area: Dakar and all regions of Senegal
